# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/refs

List all git references (branches, tags) of a repository

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-247`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |

## Response

**200** — []Reference

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `ref` | string | Reference name (e.g. refs/heads/main) |
| `url` | string | API URL for this reference |
| `object` | GitObject | Git object this reference points to |

- **404** — No refs found or repository not found
- **500** — Internal error reading git refs
